notes: BICEP/Keck XIV: search for axion-like CMB polarization oscillations using 2012-2015 Keck Array data. New 95%-confidence upper limits on axion-photon coupling for m in 1e-23 to 1e-18 eV, assuming axions constitute all local DM (kappa*rho0 = 0.3 GeV/cm^3). Data points computed from the paper's smoothed analytic limit (Eq. 15): g < 4.3e-12 GeV^-1 * (m/1e-21 eV) / sinc(m/5.0e-19 eV) * [1 - 2(m0/m)^2(1-cos(m/m0))]^{-1/2} with m0 = 1.9e-23 eV; in the flat-sensitivity region (1-30 d periods, 1.6e-21 to 4.8e-20 eV) the limit is g < 4.5e-12 GeV^-1 * (m/1e-21 eV). Limits do not exclude previously unexplored parameter space but are an independent direct-detection probe.
